notes.title: Art Books for sale + Final Planned Update!
notes.content:
[b]Art Books for Sale![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41420254/8787f441ee1fa6de26f1b5d7d4e5d2b34689b1bb.jpg[/img]

Our art books are now on sale! This is the only printing we will ever do of the art books, as this was a reward for our Kickstarter backers. We're selling the surplus, so the supply is very limited. Anyone who gets an art book will also get stickers of Rico & Flint, and the first ten customers will get stickers of Lark & Carlota as well! This is limited to Canada and the US. [url=https://sites.google.com/view/sinsisters/merch]You can get an artbook (and the bonus stickers) on our website.[/url]

[b]Game Update![/b]

This is the final planned update! It's very small, but we hope it will help new players. The update includes:

[list]
[*]An in-game lexicon: players can click on words or phrases that are in other languages or are archaic for definitions or context (we've also remove some words that didn't need to be in Spanish in the first place). Players can choose whether these words are underlined or not from the options menu.

[*]Updated tutorial: The tutorials are text-based rather than image-based for screen-readers. There's one tutorial for the dictionary and another for dialogue options. Players will have the option to view the tutorial, skip it, or skip all tutorials. The tutorials can now be accessed at any time from the options menu.

[*]Updated splash screen: We've updated the splash screen to reflect our new logo. It's cute!
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has supported, played, wishlisted, and/or reviewed [i]The Spanish Privateer[/i]! Reviews really help with visibility, but above all, getting to hear about a player's experience is really rewarding!

notes.title: Patch: Chibi CGs + Tooltip!
notes.content:
We've added a bunch of Chibi CGs, bringing the total to nine, three for each LI. If you've already finished the game and want to quickly unlock the CGs, check the gallery to get an idea of where the CG occurs. Flint has one CG in the prologue during the drinking scene, and the rest are on the main routes of each respective LI.

Additionally, we've added a tooltip so that when you hover over Carlota's personality meters, the name of each meter will appear over your mouse.
